title: 3DO DevBench — API explorer
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: OpenAPI
items.text: The REST API's OpenAPI 3 spec, for Postman/Insomnia.

items.label: Endpoints
items.text: POST /api/sessions/{pid}/cmd/{name} for every command, plus sessions, projects, screen.png, SSE events and MCP at /mcp.

items.label: Commands
items.text: Each command with its description, parameters (* = required, = default), a form to call it and its curl line.
